Overview

Mechelen is a city in Antwerp with a population of 86,000. A centrally located city with a magnificent Gothic cathedral, lively market square, and excellent rail connections to Brussels and Antwerp. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
